name: [Negative] High Brokerage Charges & Scam Fears
description: Customers are frustrated with excessive brokerage charges, feeling scammed by Groww's transaction fees, and experiencing issues with account accessibility. They criticize the app for lack of understanding and high commissions, suggesting it's a scam. Some reviewers appreciate Groww for its user-friendly interface and ease of investment but criticize the fees.

name: [Negative] High Brokerage Charges
description: Users are complaining about the high brokerage charges imposed by Groww, which is affecting their trading experience. The charges are perceived as high, especially for low-investment and short-term traders.

name: [Negative] Excessive and misleading brokerage fees
description: Users report that Groww’s brokerage charges are higher than advertised, often exceeding the cost of the trade itself, leading to losses and eroding trust in the platform.
